title: Small nonprofit CRM adoption decision
question: Should a 12-person nonprofit switch its donor database from spreadsheets to a dedicated CRM tool this quarter, given a limited budget and one part-time admin staff member?
expected_deliverable: A clear go/no-go recommendation for this quarter, with a concrete near-term action plan.
important_constraints: solution must work without dedicated IT staff
existing historical donor data must be preserved
only one part-time staff member is available to operate whatever is chosen
review_notes: Simple, bounded, single-decision case. Used as the canary/example case during harness development -- see AUDIT_REPORT.md.
